body.purpose: Conversation, settings, descriptions, and operational content.

label.purpose: Controls, metadata, chips, and secondary navigation.

mono.purpose: Code, paths, commands, logs, and identifiers.

shadows.name: modal-small
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, popovers, and transient surfaces above the workspace.

motion.name: state-color

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact inverse action used for the strongest local commitment in the dark scenic workspace.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--foreground); color:var(--background); font:500 14px/1 var(--font-sans); transition:background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 90%, var(--background)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 80%, var(--background)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral action that stays subordinate to the work surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); color:var(--foreground); font:500 14px/1 var(--font-sans); transition:background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-chrome utility action for dense toolbars and panel controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:32px; padding:6px 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); font:500 13px/1 var(--font-sans); transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 3%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact field with an optical border and no unnecessary fill.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:36px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 15%, transparent); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); font:400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition:border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 50%, var(--background)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:transparent; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact state metadata; semantic variants preserve the same geometry.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:var(--foreground); color:var(--background); font:600 12px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-badge:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 80%, var(--background)); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A text-led panel destination with a restrained tonal hover state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; width:100%; height:36px; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); color:var(--foreground); font:500 14px/1 var(--font-sans); text-align:left; transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); } .ds-nav-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A restrained container that groups related content without becoming dashboard chrome.
components.css: .ds-card { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:16px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); border-radius:8px; background:var(--background); color:var(--foreground); box-shadow:rgba(var(--foreground-rgb), .06) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,.04) 0 1px 1px -.5px; font:400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-card strong { font-weight:600; } .ds-card span { color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 55%, var(--background)); } .ds-card:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 15%, transparent); } .ds-card:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

narrative.overview:
Craft Agents behaves like a calm command desk for consequential parallel work. The interface is dense without feeling cramped: content stays dominant, chrome recedes, and controls reveal enough state to make agent activity understandable and interruptible. Precision comes from consistent geometry, compact rhythm, and semantic color rather than decoration.

The system is desktop-native in posture and web-based in implementation. It favors quiet neutral planes, small tonal steps, restrained motion, and controls that are contained and precise. It must avoid both generic SaaS-dashboard composition and the cryptic hostility of an expert-only IDE: power remains visible and accessible without turning every surface into a card, metric, icon, or ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic color used sparingly for state and permission.
Vision OS scenic glass is the default theme; alternate themes remain supported.
Custom themes may change atmosphere without changing hierarchy or behavior.

rules.name: The Vision OS Default Rule
rules.body: Vision OS scenic gray is the product default. Violet is not the default brand or execution color.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Operational Cyan identifies meaning; it does not decorate neutral content or compete with semantic status colors.

rules.name: The Tonal Structure Rule
rules.body: Prefer foreground mixed into the background at small, repeatable steps for hover, borders, muted surfaces, and separators.

rules.name: The Operational Scale Rule
rules.body: Increase weight before size. The app shell must not use marketing-scale headings to manufacture hierarchy.

rules.name: The Technical Truth Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for content whose fixed-width structure or literal identity matters, not as ambient developer styling.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by small tonal shifts before shadows are considered.

rules.name: The Stable Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs only on non-scrolling chrome proven not to trigger Chromium/Metal recomposition artifacts.

dos: Do preserve the 4px spacing rhythm and compact 32–40px control heights.
Do derive neutral surfaces from background and foreground so custom light, dark, and scenic themes remain coherent.
Do use semantic color for permission, health, warning, success, and failure.
Do design panel content against its container width and keyboard focus zone.
Do keep agent state visible, textual, and interruptible.
Do maintain accessible names, focus-visible treatments, reduced-motion behavior, and adequate pointer targets.
donts: Don't turn the shell into a generic SaaS dashboard made of repetitive cards, decorative KPIs, gradient headlines, or promotional chrome.
Don't imitate a hostile IDE through cryptic icon-only navigation, unnecessary monospace text, or density without hierarchy.
Don't introduce one-off colors when a derived neutral or semantic role already communicates the state.
Don't use large shadows, blur, or glass on scrolling content.
Don't use accent color as decoration or as a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't create a second panel or workflow surface when the existing app shell or contextual sidebar owns the task.
